text:
alex: CI red on PR #492 (infra/refactor). pre-commit/typecheck failing on mypy step. @maria did your annotation change land in this branch?

ci-bot: build #492 — step `typecheck` failed. logs attached.

alex: error snippet:
```
src/redwood/runtime/kvcache.py:142: error: Argument 2 to "update" has incompatible type "Optional[Dict[str, Any]]"; expected "Mapping[str, Any]"
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 320 source files)
```

maria: ugh, I remember touching that file. I made the helper return Optional for the cache metadata. should have kept Mapping. will repro locally.

sam: quick try: `pre-commit run mypy --files src/redwood/runtime/kvcache.py` or `tox -e py39-typecheck` to match CI.

maria: running `pre-commit` now. if it's deterministic I can push a tiny tweak.

tara: can someone queue a rerun while maria looks? might be blocking other PRs in the queue.

alex: @ci-bot please rerun build #492 (manual request). :pray:

ci-bot: rebuild requested -> queued as #492.rebuild.1

jon: note: if this ends up flaky we can bisect, but this error looks like a strict typing mismatch — not a transient flake.

maria: confirmed locally. mypy fails the same. I'm going to change the helper return type to `Mapping[str, Any] | None` and add a comment explaining why None is allowed. will open PR commit to the branch in ~8m.

sam: FYI you can also add an explicit cast or `# type: ignore[arg-type]` as a very small diff if you want to unblock faster, but longer term the signature fix is better.

maria: prefer fixing signature. pushing now.

alex: thanks — ping here when CI green. if rerun comes back red after maria's push we'll bisect or run the exact CI container locally with `docker run` image used by the pipeline.

ci-bot: #492.rebuild.1 started -> running typecheck step...

maria: pushed fix (force-push to branch).

ci-bot: #492.rebuild.1 typecheck -> success. full build still running.

alex: excellent. I'll let the queue finish and then merge once other checks pass.

maria: thanks all. leaving a quick note in the PR about the signature change and why.

sam: nice, thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

jon: moving on — if anyone sees repeated false positives for the mapping vs dict cases we should add a short test to catch regressions.

alex: agreed. adding to backlog.
